title: PostgreSQL / Clusters
description: Curated view of every CloudNativePG cluster of the lab side by side (keycloak-db, dtrack-db): up, connections vs max_connections, long transactions, wraparound, locks, throughput, cache hit ratio, deadlocks, database growth, WAL and the metrics collector. Queries come from the official CloudNativePG dashboard, the CNPG default monitoring queries and the CNPG alert rules (sources in each panel). Full per-cluster view: 'CloudNativePG / Official'.

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What runs here.** The CloudNativePG operator (namespace `cnpg-system`, operator 1.30.1) runs two PostgreSQL 18
clusters, each a **single instance** on a `local-path` volume: `keycloak/keycloak-db` (Keycloak) and
`dependency-track/dtrack-db` (Dependency-Track). No replicas (no failover: a node or Pod problem means downtime), no
separate WAL volume, **no CNPG backups** — the data is only protected by Velero's daily file-level copy of the volume.
Metrics come from the instance manager exporter on port 9187 (`cnpg_*`), scraped through the PodMonitor the operator creates.

**Healthy looks like:** up, connections well below 80 % of `max_connections` (100), longest transaction seconds not minutes,
XID age far below 300 M, 0 blocked backends, 0 deadlocks, 0 collector errors, WAL `.ready` files at 0.

**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 cnpg status <cluster> -n <ns>` (plugin) or
`kubectl --context k8s01 -n <ns> get cluster <cluster> -o yaml`; logs with
`kubectl --context k8s01 -n <ns> logs <cluster>-1 -c postgres`. Long transaction / blocked → find the session in
`pg_stat_activity` (`kubectl cnpg psql`). Connections near max → the app's pool size (Dependency-Track keeps ~15).
⚠ `cnpg_cache_hits` / `cnpg_cache_miss` are the *exporter's* query-cache counters, not PostgreSQL's buffer cache: the
buffer cache hit ratio below is computed from `pg_stat_database`.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when the instance manager can query PostgreSQL (cnpg_collector_up). 0 or no value = the database is down (the CNPG chart's alert CNPGClusterOffline fires when no instance reports up for 5 min). Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/tree/main/charts/cluster/prometheus_rules.

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Connections in use as a share of max_connections, per instance. Warning at 80 %, critical at 95 % (CNPG chart alerts CNPGClusterHighConnections*). At 100 % new connections are refused. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/tree/main/charts/cluster/prometheus_rules; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_backends_total{pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"}) / max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_settings_setting{name="max_connections",pod=~"($cluster)-[0-9]+"})

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction per instance. Long transactions hold locks and stop VACUUM from cleaning dead rows (table bloat). The CNPG sample alert LongRunningTransaction fires above 300 s. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: XID age (wraparound)
panels.description: Transactions since the oldest unfrozen transaction ID in any database. PostgreSQL must freeze rows before ~2.1 billion or it stops accepting writes; autovacuum normally keeps this far below 200 M (autovacuum_freeze_max_age). CNPG sample alert PGDatabaseXidAge: > 300 M. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml; https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/routine-vacuuming.html#VACUUM-FOR-WRAPAROUND.

panels.title: Blocked backends
panels.description: Backends currently waiting for a lock held by another backend (CNPG default query backends_waiting). Brief non-zero values are normal under write contention; a persistent value means a blocking session. The CNPG sample alert BackendsWaiting uses > 300. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/blob/cloudnative-pg-v0.29.1/charts/cloudnative-pg/values.yaml (monitoringQueriesConfigMap); https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml.

panels.title: Collector errors
panels.description: 1 when the last metrics collection of the instance failed (a monitoring query errored): the other panels may then show stale or missing data. Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since PostgreSQL started on each instance (pg_postmaster_start_time). A small value = recent restart (Pod restart, OOM, operator rolling update). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: PostgreSQL version
panels.description: Server version reported by each instance. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Application DB size
panels.description: Size of each application database (pg_database_size). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Volume used (node disk)
panels.description: Used share of the PGDATA volume. With `local-path` the volume is a directory on the node disk, so this is the **node filesystem** usage (the 5Gi request is not enforced). CNPG chart alerts CNPGClusterLowDiskSpace: warning > 70 %, critical > 90 %. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/tree/main/charts/cluster/prometheus_rules; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: WAL files waiting to archive
panels.description: WAL segments with a `.ready` file in pg_wal/archive_status: written but not yet archived. They should stay at 0; a growing number means archiving is failing and pg_wal will fill the disk. Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Base backups
panels.description: Timestamp of the last CNPG base backup. 0 = no backup has ever been taken: these clusters have no `spec.backup` (no Barman Cloud plugin), so point-in-time recovery is impossible and the only copy is Velero's daily file-level copy of the volume. Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Backends per instance and state (active, idle, idle in transaction, …). Many `idle in transaction` sessions = an application that opens transactions and does not close them. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/blob/cloudnative-pg-v0.29.1/charts/cloudnative-pg/values.yaml (monitoringQueriesConfigMap).

panels.title: Connections by application
panels.description: Backends per database, user and application_name — which client holds the connections (Keycloak JDBC pool, Dependency-Track pool, the CNPG metrics exporter itself). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/blob/cloudnative-pg-v0.29.1/charts/cloudnative-pg/values.yaml (monitoringQueriesConfigMap).

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second per database. A rising rollback share points at application errors (constraint violations, aborted transactions). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Rows written and read
panels.description: Rows inserted/updated/deleted (writes) and fetched (reads via indexes) per second per database. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Buffer cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers (blks_hit) instead of being read from the OS/disk (blks_read), per database. Low and falling = the working set no longer fits in memory (raise shared_buffers / memory limit). Source: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/monitoring-stats.html; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json. Derived query: blks_hit / (blks_hit + blks_read) over the window, the standard ratio from the pg_stat_database counters (the official dashboard plots the two counters).

panels.title: Longest transaction by application
panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction per database/application. Spikes line up with batch jobs (Dependency-Track vulnerability analysis); a line that keeps growing is a stuck session. Threshold line at 300 s (CNPG sample alert). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml.

panels.title: Blocked backends and deadlocks
panels.description: Backends waiting on locks (left) and deadlocks detected per hour (right). The CNPG sample alert DatabaseDeadlockConflicts fires above 10 deadlocks per hour. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Temporary files
panels.description: Bytes written to temporary files per second (sorts and hashes that did not fit in work_mem). Sustained values = raise work_mem for that workload or add an index. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of each application database over time. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Database growth (24h)
panels.description: Change of each database size over the previous 24 h — the trend to project disk usage. Negative after a VACUUM FULL or a large delete. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json. Derived query: delta(cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes[1d]) on the gauge.

panels.title: WAL generated
panels.description: WAL bytes generated per second (pg_stat_wal via cnpg_collector_wal_bytes). Drives disk I/O, archive volume and (with replicas) replication traffic. Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/.

panels.title: WAL on disk
panels.description: Size of pg_wal per instance (cnpg_collector_pg_wal value=size) — it should stay roughly flat around min_wal_size..max_wal_size; steady growth means WAL cannot be recycled (archiving stuck or a replication slot holding it). Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/1.30/monitoring/; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: WAL archiving
panels.description: WAL segments waiting to be archived (.ready) and archive failures per hour. With no backup configured CNPG's archive command completes immediately, so `.ready` must stay 0. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/blob/v1.30.1/docs/src/samples/monitoring/prometheusrule.yaml.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Checkpoints per hour, requested (forced because max_wal_size was reached) vs timed (checkpoint_timeout). Many requested checkpoints = write bursts larger than max_wal_size (PostgreSQL docs: raise max_wal_size). Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json; https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/wal-configuration.html.

panels.title: Collection duration
panels.description: Time the instance manager spends running the monitoring queries, per query group. Slow collections (seconds) delay metrics and load the database. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Operator reconcile errors
panels.description: Failed reconciliations of the CloudNativePG operator per controller (cluster, backup, pooler, …). `requeue_after` results are normal and not shown. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json; https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Operator
panels.description: CloudNativePG operator Pod ready (kube-state-metrics) and scraped. Without the operator running databases keep serving, but nothing heals, rotates certificates or applies spec changes. Source: https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json. Derived query: the official panel's Pod regex expects cloudnative-pg-*/cnpg-controller-manager-*; here the Deployment is `cnpg` (fullnameOverride).

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory of each postgres container (solid) and its limit (dashed, 1 GiB). PostgreSQL uses spare memory for its caches; an OOM kill restarts the database. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used by each postgres container. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin; https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/grafana-dashboards/blob/7dd1bc255b5202530e1bae7b858a3bb41a2028c7/charts/cluster/grafana-dashboard.json.
